page.layout: One page of text, one column; running head at top; page number top right; signature at foot right; marginal notes in the left margin (cut and partly illegible, not transcribed as notes beyond the reference marks visible in the text).

main_text.p: tis confideratur, vt capitis diadema, tiara, mitra, galerus, petasus, pileus, birretum, capitium, vitta, reticulum, peplum, &c.
Pedis veftimentum eft calceus ex corio, ligno, vel alia materia, calopodia, calones, sandalium, perones, ocreæ, &c.
Manus veftimentum eft chirotheca, anulus, gemma.
Trunci corporis veftimentum eft thorax, pallium, chlæna.

Veftitus candidus, eft habitus puritatis & innocentiæ, Apocalyps. c. 3. 4. Qui non inquinarunt vestimenta sua, ideoq; incedent mecum albati: digni enim sunt. 5. Qui vicerit, amicietur vestimentis albis, &c. 19. 8. Et datum est ei ut amiciatur bysso pura & splendida. Byssus enim iustificationes sunt sanctorum, Iohann. cap. 20. 12. Matth. cap. 17. 2. Ador. cap. 1. 10. Ecce viri duo adstiterunt illis albo vestitu. Sic enim Angeli boni visi leguntur albo vestitu. Matth. cap. 28. Marc. c. 16. Ioh. cap. 20. & Christus, Marc. c. 9. & Matth. c. 17. Luc. cap. 23. vid. Ecclesiast. c. 9. 10. Baptizandorum vestitus olim quoque candidus erat in primitiva Ecclesia. Stuckius libr. 2. cap. 26. convivial. antiquit. & Clemens Alexand. Pædag. lib. 2. c. 10. & lib. 3. c. 11. Aret. problem. 120.

Ergo lætitiæ, puritatis, integritatis, fincerita-tis, felicitatis, libertatis, victoriæ habitum indi-cat color vestium albus. vid. Lipf. Electi. c. 13. lib. 1. Stuck. d. lib. 2. c. 26. Clement. Alex. d. loco. Pau. libr. 1. Sentent. tit. de sepulch. Alex. ab Alex. libr. 5. Genial. dier. c. 18. Ideo in honorum & munerum petitione co-petitores albo vestitu utebantur, & candidati diceban-tur. Stuck & Plut. d. locis.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left edge are cut and largely illegible; the italic reference lines in the body are reproduced as printed where legible. Several words in the scan are doubtful (e.g. "bysso", "ideoq;", "Matth. cap. 17") and may be misread; the Latin reference lines are only partially legible and were transcribed with [?] omitted for brevity. The signature and page number are as printed at the foot and top right.
